librtlsdr - the krakenrf fork
=============================

  repository  https://github.com/krakenrf/librtlsdr
  commit      08fb08165ecfcdd954c7a20cb1bbfbc159294f0e  (master, "bump cmake
              version for cmake v4.x compatibility")
  fetched     2026-09-30
  licence     GPL-2.0-or-later (COPYING)

Why this fork: it adds rtlsdr_set_dithering() (R820T PLL dithering off - the
five tuners are never phase-coherent with it on) on top of the librtlsdr
organisation's tree, which also carries rtlsdr_set_bias_tee_gpio() (the
KrakenSDR's noise source is GPIO 0 of channel 0's RTL2832U; channel m's
bias tee is GPIO m+1 of the same chip - Heimdall's usage) and
rtlsdr_is_tuner_PLL_locked().

What is vendored: include/*.h and src/librtlsdr.c + the tuner drivers,
exactly as at that commit, plus ONE generated file, src/rtl_app_ver.h
(upstream makes it from rtl_app_ver.h.in with CMake; the values are the
0.8 in upstream's CMakeLists.txt). Nothing else is modified. The command
line tools, the RPC client and the UDP control server are not built.

Windows: librtlsdr.c includes <pthread.h>; vendor/win32/pthread.h supplies
the calls it uses on Win32 primitives (see that file), so no pthreads
library is needed.

Updating: a new commit is a deliberate act - copy the same files from the
new commit, regenerate rtl_app_ver.h if the version moved, rebuild, and run
the whole suite (build.bat, then python -m pytest tests) before changing the
commit above.
